name: 001_basic_copy_source_dest.sh
exercises: basic copy of a single SOURCE to a new DEST file
expected: DEST is created and its contents equal SOURCE contents
manpage_quote: Copy SOURCE to DEST, or multiple SOURCE(s) to DIRECTORY.

name: 002_multiple_sources_to_directory.sh
exercises: multiple SOURCE arguments copied into a DIRECTORY
expected: each SOURCE basename exists inside the destination DIRECTORY
manpage_quote: cp [OPTION]... SOURCE... DIRECTORY

name: 003_target_directory_short.sh
exercises: -t DIRECTORY copies all SOURCE arguments into DIRECTORY
expected: all SOURCEs land inside the -t DIRECTORY
manpage_quote: copy all SOURCE arguments into DIRECTORY

name: 004_target_directory_long.sh
exercises: --target-directory=DIRECTORY long form
expected: SOURCE copied into the named DIRECTORY
manpage_quote: -t, --target-directory=DIRECTORY

name: 005_no_target_directory_dest_as_file.sh
exercises: -T treats DEST as a normal file
expected: DEST itself becomes the copy with SOURCE contents
manpage_quote: treat DEST as a normal file

name: 006_no_target_directory_over_dir_fails.sh
stderr: cp: cannot create regular file '/tmp/tmp.F0js2a4nz4/adir': Is a directory (os error 21)
exercises: -T with DEST being an existing directory
expected: nonzero exit because DEST cannot be treated as a normal file
manpage_quote: treat DEST as a normal file

name: 007_recursive_copy_directory.sh
exercises: -R copy directories recursively
expected: nested file inside the source directory appears under DEST dir
manpage_quote: copy directories recursively

name: 008_recursive_lowercase_r.sh
exercises: -r recursive copy (documented same as -R)
expected: deeply nested file is reproduced under DEST dir
manpage_quote: -R, -r, --recursive

name: 009_directory_without_recursive_fails.sh
exercises: copying a directory SOURCE without -R/-r/--recursive
expected: nonzero exit (directory copy requires recursive)
manpage_quote: copy directories recursively

name: 010_hard_link.sh
exercises: -l, --link hard link files instead of copying
expected: SOURCE and DEST share the same inode number
manpage_quote: hard link files instead of copying

name: 011_symbolic_link.sh
exercises: -s, --symbolic-link make symbolic links instead of copying
expected: DEST is a symbolic link
manpage_quote: make symbolic links instead of copying

name: 012_no_clobber_skips_existing.sh
exercises: -n, --no-clobber silently skip existing files
expected: existing DEST contents unchanged
manpage_quote: silently skip existing files

name: 013_backup_simple_suffix.sh
exercises: --backup makes a backup of each existing destination file
expected: backup file with default '~' suffix holds prior DEST contents
manpage_quote: make a backup of each existing destination file

name: 014_backup_short_b.sh
exercises: -b like --backup but takes no argument
expected: backup file with default '~' suffix exists
manpage_quote: like --backup but does not accept an argument

name: 015_backup_custom_suffix.sh
exercises: -S, --suffix=SUFFIX override the usual backup suffix
expected: backup file uses the overridden '.bak' suffix
manpage_quote: override the usual backup suffix

name: 016_nonexistent_source_fails.sh
stderr: cp: cannot stat '/tmp/tmp.IkkPlBvXdn/does_not_exist.txt': No such file or directory (os error 2)
exercises: copying a nonexistent SOURCE
expected: nonzero exit because SOURCE does not exist
manpage_quote: Copy SOURCE to DEST, or multiple SOURCE(s) to DIRECTORY.

name: 017_update_none_skips.sh
exercises: --update=none does not replace existing files, no failure
expected: existing DEST contents unchanged and exit success
manpage_quote:
no files in
       the destination are replaced, and skipped files do not induce a
       failure

name: 018_update_none_fail_errors.sh
exercises: --update=none-fail diagnoses skipped files and induces failure
expected: nonzero exit because an existing file was skipped
manpage_quote: any skipped files are diagnosed and induce a failure

name: 019_update_older_replaces.sh
exercises: -u (--update=older) replaces dest when older than source
expected: older DEST is replaced with SOURCE contents
manpage_quote:
results in files being replaced if they're older than the corresponding
       source file

name: 020_parents_full_source_name.sh
exercises: --parents uses full source file name under DIRECTORY
expected: full source path is recreated under destination DIRECTORY
manpage_quote: use full source file name under DIRECTORY

name: 021_strip_trailing_slashes.sh
exercises: --strip-trailing-slashes removes trailing slashes from SOURCE
expected: SOURCE given with trailing slash is copied successfully
manpage_quote: remove any trailing slashes from each SOURCE argument

name: 022_remove_destination.sh
exercises: --remove-destination removes existing DEST before opening it
expected: DEST replaced with SOURCE contents
manpage_quote: remove each existing destination file before attempting to open

name: 023_no_dereference_preserves_symlink.sh
exercises: -P, --no-dereference never follows symlinks in SOURCE
expected: DEST is itself a symbolic link
manpage_quote: never follow symbolic links in SOURCE

name: 024_dereference_follows_symlink.sh
exercises: -L, --dereference always follows symlinks in SOURCE
expected: DEST is a regular file, not a symlink
manpage_quote: always follow symbolic links in SOURCE

name: 025_force_backup_same_name.sh
stderr: cp: cannot create regular file '/tmp/tmp.hl5rNRUQCF/same.txt': No such file or directory (os error 2)
exercises: force+backup with SOURCE and DEST the same existing regular file
expected: a backup of SOURCE is created
manpage_quote:
cp makes a backup of SOURCE when the force and
       backup options are given and SOURCE and DEST are the same name for an
       existing, regular file

name: 026_force_unwritable_dest.sh
exercises: -f, --force removes an unopenable existing DEST and retries
expected: DEST replaced with SOURCE contents
manpage_quote:
if an existing destination file cannot be opened, remove it and
              try again

name: 027_d_preserves_links.sh
exercises: -d (same as --no-dereference --preserve=links)
expected: SOURCE symlink stays a symlink at DEST
manpage_quote: same as --no-dereference --preserve=links

name: 028_preserve_mode.sh
exercises: -p (--preserve=mode,ownership,timestamps) preserves mode
expected: DEST mode bits equal SOURCE mode bits
manpage_quote: same as --preserve=mode,ownership,timestamps

name: 029_verbose_output.sh
exercises: -v, --verbose explains what is being done
expected: non-empty stdout describing the copy
manpage_quote: explain what is being done

name: 030_archive_recursive.sh
exercises: -a, --archive (same as -dR --preserve=all) recursive tree copy
expected: nested directory tree reproduced under DEST
manpage_quote: same as -dR --preserve=all
